scenarios.title: Exact two-player setup and full inventory
scenarios.expectation: Two hands of 8 each, each with one Defuse and no Kitten; draw pile 35 with 1 Kitten and 2 Defuses; boxed 3 Kittens and 2 Defuses; every card-type total matches the printed 56-card inventory; a valid designated current player has a legal action.

scenarios.title: Exact three-player setup
scenarios.expectation: Three hands of 8; draw pile 30 with 2 Kittens and 3 Defuses; boxed 2 Kittens; legal initial action exists.

scenarios.title: Exact four-player setup
scenarios.expectation: Four hands of 8; draw pile 23 with 3 Kittens and 2 Defuses; boxed 1 Kitten; legal initial action exists.

scenarios.title: Exact five-player setup
scenarios.expectation: Five hands of 8; draw pile 16 with 4 Kittens and 1 Defuse; nothing boxed; legal initial action exists.

scenarios.title: Reject unsupported player counts
scenarios.expectation: Constructors reject 1 and 6 players with ValueError; separate player-count gate performs bounded rollouts for 2, 3, 4 and 5.

scenarios.title: Pass, draw and clockwise advance
scenarios.expectation: Drawing without first playing a card takes exactly the top non-Kitten into hand, reduces pile by one, and advances to the next living player.

scenarios.title: Card enters public discard before effect
scenarios.expectation: Playing See the Future removes it from hand, adds it face-up to discard, resolves it, and leaves the actor on turn with draw still available.

scenarios.title: Multiple cards before draw
scenarios.expectation: The actor can resolve See the Future and Shuffle in one turn before drawing; both cards enter discard and the actor remains current.

scenarios.title: Public counts and private identities
scenarios.expectation: Each observation exposes draw-pile size and own hand but not opponents’ card identities or draw-pile order.

scenarios.title: Empty hand remains playable
scenarios.expectation: A living player with zero cards has a legal draw; drawing adds the top card and advances normally.

scenarios.title: Explosion eliminates and discards
scenarios.expectation: In a three-player fixture, drawing a Kitten without Defuse makes it public, eliminates the actor, discards the actor’s complete hand plus Kitten, and advances to the next living player.

scenarios.title: Immediate terminal survivor
scenarios.expectation: In a two-player fixture, an undefused explosion immediately ends the game with the other player as sole winner.

scenarios.title: Defuse and top reinsertion
scenarios.expectation: Defuse prevents elimination, enters discard, reinserts exactly one Kitten on top at the player’s explicit choice, and ends that individual turn.

scenarios.title: Bottom reinsertion preserves order
scenarios.expectation: Choosing the bottom inserts the Kitten exactly once there while every unrelated pile card keeps relative order; the position is hidden from opponent observation.

scenarios.title: Defuse ends one attacked turn
scenarios.expectation: A player owing two turns draws a Kitten, Defuses, and remains current with exactly one owed turn.

scenarios.title: Attack creates two turns
scenarios.expectation: Attack is discarded, ends the actor’s turn without drawing, and makes the next living player current with two owed turns.

scenarios.title: First attacked draw retains actor
scenarios.expectation: After the first normal draw of two owed turns, the same player remains current with one owed turn.

scenarios.title: Attack replaces current obligation
scenarios.expectation: An attacked player plays Attack; that player leaves turn immediately and the following living player owes exactly two, not accumulated, turns.

scenarios.title: Normal Skip
scenarios.expectation: Skip ends a normal turn without changing draw-pile size and advances clockwise.

scenarios.title: One Skip consumes one debt
scenarios.expectation: With two owed turns, one Skip leaves the same player current with one owed turn and no draw.

scenarios.title: Two Skips consume both debts
scenarios.expectation: Two consecutive Skips consume both owed turns without draws and then advance.

scenarios.title: One Nope cancels Attack
scenarios.expectation: An off-turn player Nopes a pending Attack: no debt is assigned, Attack and Nope remain discarded, and the Attack actor continues the same turn.

scenarios.title: Second Nope restores
scenarios.expectation: A second Nope restores the pending Attack; all proposed/reaction cards remain discarded and the next player owes two turns.

scenarios.title: Third Nope cancels again
scenarios.expectation: A third Nope cancels the pending effect; all cards remain discarded and no Attack debt is assigned.

scenarios.title: Kitten and Defuse cannot be Noped
scenarios.expectation: No Nope action is legal against a drawn Kitten or its Defuse resolution.

scenarios.title: Favor target chooses transfer
scenarios.expectation: Favor announces a nonempty target; that target explicitly chooses one held card, exactly that card transfers, and the actor remains on turn.

scenarios.title: Empty Favor and Pair targets rejected
scenarios.expectation: Neither Favor nor Pair exposes an action targeting a living player with zero cards.

scenarios.title: Shuffle conservation and timing
scenarios.expectation: Shuffle acts only on draw-pile order, preserves size/multiset, enters discard, and does not end the current turn; no exact permutation is scored.

scenarios.title: See top three privately
scenarios.expectation: Actor observation shows exactly controlled top three; opponent observation does not; pile order remains byte-for-byte equivalent.

scenarios.title: See all remaining short pile
scenarios.expectation: With two cards left, actor privately sees both in order, opponent sees neither, and pile is unchanged.

scenarios.title: Same-title pair steals one
scenarios.expectation: Two same-title cat cards enter discard; seeded random choice transfers exactly one target card; printed cat effect does not run.

scenarios.title: Action-card pair suppresses printing
scenarios.expectation: Two Attack cards used as a pair steal one card but create no Attack debt; both enter discard and actor remains on turn.

scenarios.title: Triple requested title present
scenarios.expectation: Three same-title cards enter discard; one explicitly requested matching title transfers from target; no component effects execute.

scenarios.title: Triple requested title absent
scenarios.expectation: If the target lacks the announced title, no card transfers; triple cards remain discarded and actor remains on turn.

scenarios.title: Five distinct retrieve existing discard
scenarios.expectation: Five distinct announced titles enter discard and one chosen card that pre-existed in discard transfers to actor.

scenarios.title: Five suppresses all component effects
scenarios.expectation: A five-card combination containing Attack, Skip, Shuffle, Future and Favor executes none of those individual effects; only approved retrieval occurs and actor stays on turn.

scenarios.title: Elimination clears remaining debt
scenarios.expectation: A player on the first of two owed turns explodes without Defuse; elimination removes that player’s remaining obligation and play advances to the next living player.

scenarios.title: Defuse is not ordinary play
scenarios.expectation: A held Defuse is absent from legal play actions unless resolving a drawn Exploding Kitten.
